requirements.text: A project is described by an identifier, an artifact identifier, and a description.
A build configuration has one default goal, and one path to a unit test source directory.
A resource has one target path, a directory, and an excludes string.
A mailing list has a name, a subscribe string, and an archive string.
A person contributing to a Maven project has a name, a URL, an organization URL, and a given time zone.
A developer contributing to a Maven project has a unique identifier.
A Maven project is composed of zero to n mailing lists.
A Maven project is composed of at most one build configuration.
A build configuration is associated with at least zero and at most n resources.
